title: GitHub - meyerdav24/molt: Delegate bounded spending to an AI agent. It grows a disposable shell for every purchase, wears it once, and sheds it. Open protocol, Apache 2.0.
excerpt: Delegate bounded spending to an AI agent. It grows a disposable shell for every purchase, wears it once, and sheds it. Open protocol, Apache 2.0. - meyerdav24/molt
content_html:
An open protocol for delegating bounded, autonomous spending authority to an AI agent, at any online store, including the overwhelming majority that expose no agentic commerce protocol at all.

The name is the security model. The agent never holds your real card. For every purchase it grows a fresh, disposable shell, a single-use scoped payment credential sized exactly to that cart, wears it once, and sheds it. The agent molts after every purchase. Worst case, an attacker gets a shell: one store you already use, one capped amount, minutes from expiry.

You delegate the way you would at a bar: show ID once, open a tab with a limit, and anything unusual gets checked with you.

The blast radius, up front: prompt injection is assumed, not hoped away. Every purchase runs on a child mandate that can never exceed the tab you signed, is scoped to one store and one exact cart, and dies after one authorization. A compromised agent cannot send your money somewhere new: a store the tab has never paid holds for your passkey, so the classic injection, "buy this at attacker.example", never grows a shell. At a store you already use, it is bounded by your per-purchase cap, your velocity limit, and what is left of the tab. That claim, and its limits, are written down in the threat model.

Watch the five-minute demo: the agent earns testnet USDC, a fingerprint signs the limits, purchases run alone, a duplicate cart is refused, an unknown store waits for a thumb, and the receipt verifies offline.

Status: test-mode beta. Live at moltprotocol.dev, docs at moltprotocol.dev/docs. Nothing moves real money: the reference Tab Authority runs exclusively against Stripe test mode and testnet USDC (Base Sepolia), and refuses to boot otherwise.

The three-party model

User ──(one passkey ceremony)──> Tab Authority ──(scoped credentials)──> Agent ──> any merchant
                                      │
                                      └── receipts, audit log, step-up channel

The merchant is deliberately not a party. It installs nothing, agrees to nothing, and sees an ordinary card transaction.

Repository layout

Path What it is
SPEC.md The protocol specification (v0.1-draft)
packages/protocol JSON Schemas, mandate-tree engine, receipt signing, molt verify CLI
packages/adapters Platform detector, checkout adapters, request signing (the Stamp), x402 client
apps/web Reference Tab Authority: dashboard, step-up page, REST API, webhooks, docs
apps/mcp-server MCP server exposing the five agent tools
apps/demo-seller Demo x402 paid API
demo/ Demo kit: vocabulary card, agent prompt, reset script, dry-run findings
supabase/ Database migrations

Quickstart

You need Docker and a free Stripe account with Issuing enabled in test mode.

git clone https://github.com/meyerdav24/molt && cd molt
cp .env.example .env
docker compose up

.env.example lists everything, but only four values are needed to reach a working tab; each is explained inline where it sits:

Variable What to put there
MOLT_SESSION_SECRET any long random string
MOLT_TA_SIGNING_KEY the generator one-liner is in the file
STRIPE_API_KEY a test-mode restricted key (rk_test_…) with Issuing cardholders + cards write
EMAIL_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM a Resend key for step-up mails. Skip it at first; held purchases then wait without an email

Then register at localhost:3000/login with a passkey and open a tab. That passkey ceremony is the one human moment in the whole flow; everything after it is the agent.

The build takes under a minute, the images a few minutes to pull, and the rest of the ten is the Stripe account. Step-by-step, including the first purchase and the dev-store caveats: /docs/quickstart. Full docs (MCP setup, API reference, rendered spec, FAQ) live under /docs, served by the app itself.

Connect an agent (MCP)

The MCP server exposes five tools: open_tab, connect_tab, resolve_merchant, purchase, get_receipts. Opening a tab always happens in the browser with your passkey; the agent only ever receives the ceremony URL. Any MCP client works; two examples:

Hermes Agent (~/.hermes/config.yaml):

mcp_servers:
  molt:
    command: 'node'
    args: ['/path/to/molt/apps/mcp-server/dist/index.js']
    env:
      MOLT_API_URL: 'https://moltprotocol.dev'
      MOLT_AGENT_KEY: 'molt_sk_test_...'
      MOLT_SHIPPING_PROFILE: '{"email":"you@example.com","first_name":"Ada","last_name":"Lovelace","address1":"Teststr. 1","city":"Munich","zip":"80331","country_code":"DE"}'

Claude Desktop (claude_desktop_config.json):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "molt": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/molt/apps/mcp-server/dist/index.js"],
      "env": {
        "MOLT_API_URL": "https://moltprotocol.dev",
        "MOLT_AGENT_KEY": "molt_sk_test_...",
        "MOLT_SHIPPING_PROFILE": "{\"email\":\"you@example.com\",\"first_name\":\"Ada\",\"last_name\":\"Lovelace\",\"address1\":\"Teststr. 1\",\"city\":\"Munich\",\"zip\":\"80331\",\"country_code\":\"DE\"}"
      }
    }
  }
}

Setup order: run the web app, ask the agent to open_tab, complete the passkey ceremony it links you to, then create an agent key in the dashboard for that tab. You can hand that key to the agent in either direction: put it in MOLT_AGENT_KEY as above and restart the host, or simply paste it into the chat and say "connect to my tab with this key" — the agent calls connect_tab and stores it locally, no config editing and no restart. The key is scoped to that one tab and its limits; a purchase can never exceed them.

Optional variables: MOLT_STOREFRONT_PASSWORDS (host|password,... for password-protected dev stores), MOLT_BOGUS_GATEWAY_HOSTS (dev stores running Shopify's Bogus Gateway, where the simulated acquirer gets its test card while the scoped card stays real), MOLT_EVIDENCE_DIR, MOLT_AGENT_SIGNING_KEY_PATH. For a remote client such as a hosted connector, run with --http [port] (Streamable HTTP, gated by MOLT_REMOTE_TOKEN); --sse [port] still serves legacy clients.

What Molt deliberately does not do

Design commitments, not roadmap gaps (full list with reasoning):

  • No bot-detection evasion. Signed requests, honest user agent; blocked means blocked, reported as such.
  • No funds custody and no payment initiation. The Tab Authority scopes; issuer rails execute.
  • No strong customer authentication, and no claim to it.
  • No crypto custody. Testnet only; keys stay with the agent operator.
  • No post-purchase guarantees. Delivery and refunds stay between you and the store.
  • No ToS dissolution. Your obligations to merchants are unchanged.

Disclaimers

  • The hosted beta at moltprotocol.dev is test-mode only. No real money moves.
  • Self-hosters operate their own issuer relationship and are responsible for their own compliance.
  • Molt is technical infrastructure. It never holds funds, never initiates payments, and never performs strong customer authentication.
  • Nothing in this repository is financial or legal advice.

License

Apache 2.0. The spec and reference implementation are Apache 2.0 permanently, and the open project will not be relicensed. If Molt is useful to you, sponsoring buys maintenance time; it buys no features, because there are no features to withhold. Once independent implementations exist, spec governance is intended to move to a neutral home. See CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md.

content_html_zh:
一种开放协议，用于在任何在线商店将有限的、自主的支出权限委托给人工智能代理，包括压倒性的大多数根本不公开代理商务协议的商店。

名称是安全模型。 代理永远不会持有您的真实卡。 每次购买时，它都会生成一个新鲜的一次性外壳，这是一个一次性范围内的支付凭证，其大小与该购物车完全一致，佩戴一次，然后将其丢弃。 每次购买后代理都会蜕皮。 最坏的情况是，攻击者会得到一个 shell：一个您已使用的商店，一个上限金额，距离到期还有几分钟。

您的委托方式与在酒吧的方式相同：出示一次 ID，打开一个有限制的选项卡，然后任何异常情况都会与您一起检查。

前面的爆炸半径：假设是立即喷射，而不是希望消失。 每次购买都基于子授权，该授权永远不会超出您签署的选项卡，范围仅限于一家商店和一个确切的购物车，并在一次授权后终止。 受感染的代理无法将您的钱发送到新的地方：选项卡从未支付过保存您的密钥的商店，因此经典注入“在攻击者.example 处购买”永远不会生成 shell。 在您已经使用的商店中，它受到您的每次购买上限、速度限制以及选项卡剩余内容的限制。 该主张及其限制都写在威胁模型中。

观看五分钟的演示：代理赚取测试网 USDC，指纹签署限制，单独运行购买，拒绝重复的购物车，未知商店等待拇指，收据离线验证。

状态：测试模式测试版。 生活在 moltprotocol.dev，文档在 moltprotocol.dev/docs。 没有什么可以移动真钱：参考 Tab Authority 专门针对 Stripe 测试模式和测试网 USDC（Base Sepolia）运行，否则拒绝启动。

三方模式

User ──(one passkey ceremony)──> Tab Authority ──(scoped credentials)──> Agent ──> any merchant
                                      │
                                      └── receipts, audit log, step-up channel

商家故意不参与其中。 它不安装任何内容，不同意任何内容，并且看到普通的卡交易。

存储库布局

Path 它是什么
SPEC.md 协议规范（v0.1-草案）
包/协议 JSON 模式、授权树引擎、收据签名、蜕皮验证 CLI
包/适配器 平台检测器、结帐适配器、请求签名（Stamp）、x402 客户端
应用程序/网络 参考选项卡权威：仪表板、升级页面、REST API、webhooks、文档
应用程序/mcp 服务器 MCP 服务器公开五个代理工具
应用程序/演示卖家 演示 x402 付费 API
demo/ 演示套件：词汇卡、代理提示、重置脚本、试运行结果
苏帕基/ 数据库迁移

快速入门

您需要 Docker 和一个在测试模式下启用发行的免费 Stripe 帐户。

git clone https://github.com/meyerdav24/molt && cd molt
cp .env.example .env
docker compose up

.env.example 列出了所有内容，但只需要四个值即可到达工作选项卡；每个都在其所在位置内嵌解释：

多变的 放什么东西在那里
VERY_SESSION_SECRET 任何长随机字符串
TOO_TA_SIGNING_KEY 生成器单行代码在文件中
STRIPE_API_KEY 测试模式限制密钥（rk_test_…） 持卡人发卡+卡写
EMAIL_API_KEY 和 EMAIL_FROM 用于升级邮件的重新发送键。 一开始就跳过它；保留购买，然后等待，没有收到电子邮件

然后使用密码在 localhost:3000/login 注册并打开一个选项卡。 钥匙仪式是整个流程中唯一的人性时刻。之后的一切都是代理。

构建过程需要不到一分钟，图像需要几分钟才能拉取，剩下的十分钟是 Stripe 帐户。 分步说明，包括首次购买和开发商店注意事项：/docs/quickstart。 完整文档（MCP 设置、API 参考、渲染规范、常见问题解答）位于 /docs 下，由应用程序本身提供。

连接代理 (MCP)

MCP 服务器公开了五个工具：open_tab、connect_tab、resolve_merchant、purchase、get_receipts。 打开选项卡总是在浏览器中使用您的密码进行；代理仅收到仪式 URL。 任何MCP客户端都可以工作；两个例子：

Hermes 代理（~/.hermes/config.yaml）：

mcp_servers:
  molt:
    command: 'node'
    args: ['/path/to/molt/apps/mcp-server/dist/index.js']
    env:
      MOLT_API_URL: 'https://moltprotocol.dev'
      MOLT_AGENT_KEY: 'molt_sk_test_...'
      MOLT_SHIPPING_PROFILE: '{"email":"you@example.com","first_name":"Ada","last_name":"Lovelace","address1":"Teststr. 1","city":"Munich","zip":"80331","country_code":"DE"}'

克劳德桌面（claude_desktop_config.json）：

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "molt": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/molt/apps/mcp-server/dist/index.js"],
      "env": {
        "MOLT_API_URL": "https://moltprotocol.dev",
        "MOLT_AGENT_KEY": "molt_sk_test_...",
        "MOLT_SHIPPING_PROFILE": "{\"email\":\"you@example.com\",\"first_name\":\"Ada\",\"last_name\":\"Lovelace\",\"address1\":\"Teststr. 1\",\"city\":\"Munich\",\"zip\":\"80331\",\"country_code\":\"DE\"}"
      }
    }
  }
}

设置顺序：运行 Web 应用程序，要求代理打开_选项卡，完成它链接到的密钥仪式，然后在仪表板中为该选项卡创建代理密钥。 您可以以任一方向将该密钥交给代理：如上所述将其放入 MOLT_AGENT_KEY 中并重新启动主机，或者只需将其粘贴到聊天中并说“使用此密钥连接到我的选项卡” - 代理调用 connect_tab 并将其存储在本地，无需编辑配置，也无需重新启动。 键的范围仅限于该选项卡及其限制；购买永远不能超过它们。

可选变量：MOLT_STOREFRONT_PASSWORDS（主机|密码，... 对于受密码保护的开发商店）、MOLT_BOGUS_GATEWAY_HOSTS（运行 Shopify 虚假网关的开发商店，模拟收单机构在其中获取测试卡，而作用域卡保持真实状态）、MOLT_EVIDENCE_DIR、MOLT_AGENT_SIGNING_KEY_PATH。 对于远程客户端（例如托管连接器），请使用 --http [port]（可流式 HTTP，由 MOLT_REMOTE_TOKEN 控制）运行； --sse [端口] 仍然为旧客户端提供服务。

Molt 故意不做的事

设计承诺，而不是路线图差距（带有推理的完整列表）：

  • 没有逃避机器人检测。 签署请求，诚实的用户代理；被阻止意味着被阻止，被报告为这样。
  • 没有资金托管，也没有发起付款。 选项卡权限范围；发行人轨道执行。
  • 没有强大的客户认证，也没有声明。
  • 没有加密货币托管。 仅测试网；钥匙由代理操作员保管。
  • 没有购买后保证。 送货和退款由您和商店负责。
  • 无 ToS 解散。 您对商家的义务没有改变。

免责声明

  • moltprotocol.dev 上的托管测试版仅是测试模式。 没有真正的资金流动。
  • 自托管者运营自己的发行人关系，并对自己的合规性负责。
  • 蜕皮是技术基础设施。 它从不持有资金，从不发起付款，也从不执行强客户身份验证。
  • 此存储库中的任何内容都不是财务或法律建议。

执照

阿帕奇2.0。 规范和参考实现永久为 Apache 2.0，并且开放项目不会重新授权。 如果Molt对你有用，赞助可以买到维护时间；它不购买任何功能，因为没有任何功能可以保留。 一旦存在独立的实现，规范治理就会转移到中立的地方。 请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md 和 SECURITY.md。
